title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode2 An Unexpected Savior

meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: The weekend
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no one else is here yet.
I might've left home a little too early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I've hit a bit of a wall with my song, so it might be nice to work on it somewhere else for a change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still... Why am I having so much trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm currently writing a song with a message about helping others when they need it, but... No matter how many times I try, it ends up sounding off...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've even tried adjusting the parts of the melody that I thought needed fixing... But that hasn't really led to an improvement in quality.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also... I'm trying to get used to digital tools, but it isn't going well. I can't quite get the melody that's in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is a lot harder than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But I want Miku to sing my song...
I've come this far already, so I need to at least finish it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still... What do I do in these situations?
I remember Saki saying...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's get started, everyone!
It's time for Ms. Saki's songwriting seminar!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was asking about how to become a better songwriter, and these two became so excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ichi!
Once again, ask me anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay, Ms. Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's even calling her “Ms. Saki” like she's a teacher.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you two doing...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-So...
What do you do when you get stuck while writing a song? Do you have any advice regarding that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent question.
Many things can cause you to get stuck while writing a song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For example, if you're having trouble producing the sound you want despite having a solid image in your head, you may want to try looking at your song objectively by taking a step back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Objectively?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Working on a song for too long can cause you to become unable to distinguish between what's good and what's bad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, whenever you find yourself in such a situation, my... Ms. Saki's advice to you is to try listening to the song you're working on using different headphones or somewhere else entirely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By doing that, you might figure out what you were missing and get the hint that you need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never would've thought to do either of those things... Thank you very much for your advice, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
And never stop learning!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, to be fair, I'm still pretty new to songwriting and also keep getting stuck...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Listening to it somewhere else entirely...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This might be the perfect place...
I think I'll try that while I wait for the others to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... Just plug the cable into my phone and press play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow... The studio's speakers sound so much cleaner... This sounds completely different compared to when I listen to it on my computer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The melody still sounds off...
It's not capturing that feeling of wanting to help someone who's in need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If anything, these speakers are only making the problems more evident...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The bass sounds...thin...
The drums sound light too. It's like everything sounds really far away...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not just the melody. I can see now that I need to also be careful about which sounds I choose... The issues are just piling up...
What song is this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
H-Honami?!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you. I should've let you know that I was here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-I'm also sorry.
My back was to the door, so I didn't see you come in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
More importantly, this song... Is that Miku singing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... So, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I've never heard this song before. It skipped in a few places, and the melody seems unfinished...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika... Did you write this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, actually...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
You were still trying to write your own song. Not only that, you're having Miku sing it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But I really just started working on it. I mean, I can't write anything amazing like Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel bad about making Miku sing such a half-baked song, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm having a lot of trouble.
Using digital tools to write songs is so hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you mean using a computer to write music? That's very different from how we usually produce songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially since you have to choose which instruments to use and what sounds they're going to make. It sounds tough...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I know what kind of song I want to write and have been inputting sounds based on how we usually play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I'm not getting what I want.
I even realized just now that my song has all these other problems with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought I'd be able to help the band more if I learned to write songs for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What if you asked Ms. Yoisaki?
She composes songs using digital tools...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right.
I remember her mentioning that before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami!
I'll try contacting her right away.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope she can help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning!
You two are here pretty early!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know you could've gotten started without us, right? Wait, why's only this speaker on...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Th-The person who used it last must've forgotten!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that is pretty common!
I remember going out and leaving the air conditioner on during summer once, Tsukasa turned into a popsicle the moment he got home!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like the temperature setting you chose is more the issue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, would you mind keeping my song a secret from the others until I've had a chance to finish it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Partly because it's embarrassing, but mostly... I want the song to be complete when they hear it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay, I promise not to tell them.
And I'll help you when I can to make sure it turns out well.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good job today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye bye, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Another day, another good practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We even got to finalize our decision to make videos moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, which song should we do a video for first?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We'll need to choose carefully.
Our first video's probably gonna leave the biggest impression about who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... Those who like our first video might become interested in us and even come to see us live.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we choose a song that we all feel good about and serves as a nice representation of who we are...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In other words... It'll be Leo/need's way of introducing itself to the world.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You said it perfect, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song that we all feel good about and serves as a nice representation of who we are... I guess that means...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
Saki's song!
The song Saki wrote!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! You all landed on the same answer!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It seems like the right choice for our first video since we practiced so much just to play it during that show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it means something special to me. All of you working hard to master it compelled me to play with everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: S-Saki, is that okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
I can't believe it'll be our first video... I mean, I worked super hard on it, so this makes me really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. For now, until we do our shoot, let's keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Unlike shows, videos last forever...
And that comes with a different sort of anxiety...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll need to practice a lot for it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Did someone just send me a message?
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming again, Ms. Mochizuki. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Welcome, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help me today. After I suddenly asked you to teach me about digital music tools too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not only that, you even invited me to your house.
I feel kind of bad about all of this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
I mean, I happen to have the equipment you need for this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, however, the house may be a bit of a mess since Ms. Mochizuki hasn't had a chance to clean it yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry. It'll be clean in no time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, if you'll excuse me, I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good luck, Ichika.
And thank you again, Ms. Yoisaki. I hope you two can make some good progress.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too.
Anyway, shall we head up to my room...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes!
